name: tyre-webshop
description: Client demo (in progress): storefront for a tyre service with a 3D tyre hero. React + TypeScript + MUI frontend, ASP.NET Core backend.

paragraphs: A modern webshop and online presence for Vulkanizer Željko, a tyre and wheel service business (tyre sales, mounting, balancing, wheel alignment, puncture repair, and seasonal tyre changes).
The site is built to immediately communicate one thing: tyres, performance, and professional automotive service — not a generic e-commerce template.

the Željko logo), the display typography (Barlow Condensed), and a 3D interactive tyre in the hero are all chosen to make the brand feel like a premium tyre company (Michelin / Pirelli / F1 garage energy) rather than a fashion or generic shop.
